name: Cupriferous-Palsa
description: Rolling continents break around shallow seas, their interiors scored by massive canyon systems. Beyond tectonic rift valleys, the land runs to a horizon that feels hand-drawn.

Standing still, you feel the temperate air press in like a verdict. Wind is the only voice here, and it repeats itself. Forests of black-leaved flora drink the dim light and exhale a scent like cold iron.
The oldest impact basin predates the system's estimated age by a comfortable margin. The survey bureau has quietly stopped publishing the numbers.
Mining charters include clauses about 'subsurface events' that lawyers refuse to define.
